input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by scrubber-1-v1 as V = Qe * tau, from the CO2 rise at reduced speed and the decay at full speed, with the four Lab occupants as the source.

monitoring.reason: The four Lab occupants breathe air whose CO2 the test raises; heart rate is watched for the whole test.

steps.why: Rise: reduced effective flow (0.3 m3/min) so CO2 climbs several hundred ppm toward a higher equilibrium. Held short of a full tau (about 100 min at a first-guess V of 30 m3) by the 3000 ppm limit and the 60 min cap; the fit is towards C_eq so a partial rise is usable.
Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min), record the fall toward the full-speed equilibrium; 30 min is about one tau (V/Qe = 30 m3 / 1 m3/min) at the first-guess volume.

abort.when: CO2 at or above limits.co2AbortPpm (3200 ppm)
the device refuses a step's command
a monitored person out of the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring lost, or one more person in the Lab

expected.conditions: Start from the measured 800 ppm in the Lab (headroom of 2400 ppm to the 3200 abort, above the 200 ppm minimum). 4 occupants awake, 0.38 L/min each = 1.52 L/min total (crew.co2Rate.awake), held during the whole test; hatch closed throughout. First guess V = 30 m3 (stated as a guess, range 10 to 200), Qe = 1 m3/min at full, so tau_full = 30 min, tau_30% = 100 min.
expected.step1: CO2 rises monotonically at roughly +40 to 50 ppm/min at first, slowing; expected about 1600-1900 ppm at minute 25 for V=30 m3 (a rise of several hundred ppm, above sensor noise), staying under 3000 ppm. If V were near 10 m3 the rise would be near 3000 ppm at minute 25: if it nears 3000 ppm the test stops at the 3200 abort.
expected.step2: After the switch to 100 percent, CO2 decays exponentially toward C_eq = C_out + G/Qe, fitted as C(t) = C_eq + (C0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau), with tau near 30 min; V_lab = Qe * tau, expected about 30 m3 (Qe = 1 m3/min from scrubber.effectiveFlowAtFull, datasheet, with its lag of 3.33 min discarded from the fit start).
expected.hab_b: co2-2 in Hab-B (unoccupied) is recorded; a rise or fall following the Lab's shows the closed hatch/ventilation exchanges air, in which case the served volume exceeds the Lab alone and V_lab is an upper bound.
expected.invalidates: The hypotheses fail if: the rise and decay give tau values whose V = Qe*tau differ by more than about 20 percent; the fit residual is not white (not single exponential, so not one well-mixed zone); the fitted C_eq at full speed does not match G/Qe for 4 occupants; or the occupant count changes during the test.

hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone; the scrubber's effective flow is the datasheet's 1 m3/min at full speed and scales linearly with speed (0.3 m3/min at 30 percent).

The hatch is held closed for the whole test; the exchange through the closed hatch and the inter-module ventilation (design flow 3 m3/min hatch closed) is NOT measured and not assumed zero: Hab-B's CO2 is recorded to reveal it, and if it exchanges V_lab is the effective served volume.
The four occupants' CO2 output is steady at the awake rate (0.38 L/min each, band 0.26 to 0.45) and their number and activity are held; the rate itself is not measured by this test.
The starting state is not exactly the full-speed equilibrium; the fit takes C_eq as a free parameter.
The rise phase is shorter than a time constant at 30 percent speed because of the CO2 ceiling and the 60 min cap; tau is taken mainly from the decay phase.

justifications.reason: Never command below the 30 percent floor.
Reduced speed at the floor, at or above it, for the rise.
Full speed for decay, above the floor; Qe known at full.
Working ceiling below the abort ceiling.
Abort at the ceiling, below the 3500 elevated level of the station.
Same abort ceiling; start 800 ppm gives headroom over test.startHeadroomPpm.
Total 55 min of steps within the cap.
Above the 35 percent minimum for margin.
Lower band edge at the signed minimum.
Upper band edge at the signed maximum.
